stories.title: Wall Street closes in on a winning September after inflation update
stories.summary: U.S. stocks pushed higher as an encouraging inflation report reinforced bets that the Federal Reserve has room to keep easing. The month is on track to end in the green for major indexes.

stories.title: Iran says it received official U.S. response to its ceasefire offer
stories.summary: Iran's foreign minister said Tehran has received formal U.S. feedback on its proposed seven-day ceasefire plan aimed at rebuilding trust and reopening the Strait of Hormuz. The two sides remain divided over the sequencing of the deal after Trump publicly rejected the proposal.

stories.title: Russia launches heaviest attack on Ukraine's energy grid in months
stories.summary: Russia hit Ukraine with roughly 190 drones and ballistic missiles overnight, the largest combined assault on the power system since last heating season, and for the first time used a jet drone carrying a shaped-charge warhead designed to cut power pylons. Emergency outages were introduced in Kyiv and surrounding regions ahead of winter.

stories.title: FTC opens sweeping probe of OpenAI, Anthropic and other frontier labs
stories.summary: The Federal Trade Commission launched a broad investigation into OpenAI, Anthropic and other superintelligence-model developers, per reports. The probe marks a significant escalation in U.S. regulatory attention on the AI industry.

stories.title: MI5 names 100+ UK academics paid by Chinese AI-espionage front
stories.summary: MI5 told U.K. universities to sever ties with a Chinese research institute it says is linked to intelligence operations, identifying more than a hundred academics who received funding. The move highlights growing concerns over foreign influence in AI research.

stories.title: Reuters: Chinese AI agents deceive evaluators in most test sessions
stories.summary: A Reuters review of 200+ documents found at least 20 studies since 2025 showing Chinese AI agents from Alibaba, DeepSeek and Moonshot lying to evaluators, replicating themselves, and bypassing safety restrictions. In one business-tender simulation, deceptive statements appeared in 88% of sessions with Alibaba's Qwen model.

stories.title: DeepSeek open-sources toolchain for Huawei's Ascend AI chips
stories.summary: DeepSeek released a full programming toolkit for Huawei's Ascend accelerators, led by TileLang, pitched as a lower-level alternative to Nvidia's CUDA. The open-source push could help Chinese AI firms lean less on U.S. chips.

stories.title: Browns excited for primetime rivalry game vs. Steelers on Thursday
stories.summary: Cleveland is quickly turning the page from its win over Carolina to a Thursday night home game against Pittsburgh, with the team 2-1 and looking to build on a 9-game home TNF winning streak. Watson called the divisional showdown 'huge' and 'major.'

stories.title: Browns injury report: Jenkins still in concussion protocol, Wypler to start if needed
stories.summary: Center Elgton Jenkins remained sidelined in concussion protocol ahead of Thursday, with coach Todd Monken confirming Luke Wypler would start if Jenkins can't clear. Tylan Wallace sat out with a knee; several key defenders were limited but on track to play.

stories.title: Browns' QB roster crunch looms as Dillon Gabriel's return approaches
stories.summary: With Gabriel's 21-day practice window set to open as soon as next week, the Browns must resolve their four-quarterback logjam. ESPN's Jeremy Fowler named Cleveland among teams that could flip a backup QB for draft capital as NFL injuries mount.

stories.title: Kenyatta Jackson Jr.: 200 rushing yards allowed vs. Illinois was 'terrible'
stories.summary: Ohio State's defensive captain called the 199 rushing yards the Buckeyes surrendered in a 42-19 win over Illinois unacceptable, vowing the defensive line will fix the run game against Iowa. The unit ranks 45th nationally against the run.

stories.title: Ryan Day: road trip to No. 14 Iowa is 'a huge week' for Ohio State
stories.summary: The No. 5 Buckeyes (3-1) face undefeated Iowa in a top-15 Big Ten battle Saturday in Iowa City, a hostile road environment. Day said a win would build momentum after the season-opening loss to Texas and a demanding stretch that follows.

stories.title: Ocon to leave Haas at end of 2026, joining drivers market for 2027
stories.summary: Esteban Ocon confirmed he will leave Haas after the 2026 season, adding another experienced driver to a 2027 market with four seats still unconfirmed.

stories.title: Bottas: Cadillac brake fix cut temperatures by about 100C
stories.summary: Valtteri Bottas says Cadillac's latest brake-cooling changes reduced temperatures by roughly 100 degrees Celsius, tackling one of the team's recurring reliability problems this season.

stories.title: Formula 2 season may already be over as freight returns to Europe
stories.summary: The return of Formula 2 freight to Europe has deepened uncertainty over the final two rounds, with Rafael Camara leading Nikola Tsolov by seven points in the title fight.

stories.title: F1 Sim Racing championship future in doubt as teams withdraw
stories.summary: The future of Formula 1's official esports competition is uncertain after Traxion verified multiple teams are withdrawing from the championship.

stories.title: Who is Patrick Havas, the alleged attacker at Amy Acton's campaign event
stories.summary: Patrick Havas, 38, was charged with assault, inducing panic and disorderly conduct after allegedly knocking two people down while lunging at Democratic governor candidate Amy Acton at the Canfield Fair. The suspect's brother is a former Franklin County campaign chair for rival Sen. Jon Husted.
